name: Colony Economy
description: Colonies get a designation (Industrial, Trade Hub, Resort World, Mining Hub, Core World or Frontier/Garrison) with bonuses and drawbacks through the game's own mechanics: construction speed, income, tourism, mining rates, growth, troops, approval. Refineries make five refined goods that freighters haul to the shipyards (faster builds with them, slower without). The private sector spends its idle money on private facilities that fit the designation (four per designation, one to three slots by colony size, some mutually exclusive), and the player can request one. When the treasury runs low the state borrows from its own private sector with bonds, repaid with interest from taxes; an Investment Bank lowers the rate. AI empires designate, build and borrow too. Map icons show the designations (overlay toggle).
